hawkes.reason: no measured per-sector Hawkes intensity is produced by this run; FR14 sector baselines are not yet persisted (FIX07)

sector_aggregates.separation_note: these are two different measurements. News sector stress is an ordinal severity derived from events and documented exposure. Hawkes sector stress is a measured branching-ratio diagnostic. They are not comparable and are never combined into one number

edges.note: a documented relationship with its own evidence, not a fitted contagion edge and not a CSRS quantity

hidden_edges.reason: more than 24 documented paths are visible at this decision time; the rest are hidden for legibility and are listed here. Hidden is not absent

unresolved.reason: no evidenced coordinate or mapped geometry for this record; it stays in the signal rail and the review queue rather than being drawn somewhere plausible

review_queue.note: these records have evidence but no mapped geometry. They are reviewable work, not errors, and they are deliberately not drawn

provenance.semantics: publishing office or issuing jurisdiction; not event occurrence

origins.semantics: evidenced event occurrence; never inferred from publisher office

mentions.legend: named in the story; role not established
mentions.semantics: the location appears in the text. Whether it is affected, the origin, or merely a venue is not something a name match can decide, so no impact is claimed here

affected.semantics: an evidenced exposure relationship reaches here; it is not a loss estimate

paths.semantics: an ExposureEdge with its own evidence

market_diagnostics.reason: no measured per-location pillar diagnostic exists

preview.note: no illustrative dataset is attached to this payload

limitations: 1 evidenced record(s) have no mapped geometry and are not drawn; they are in the review queue
news mechanisms are ordinal and evidential. They are not probabilities of financial loss and share no scale with CSRS
channel_note: this is the news channel (F2). It is separate from the market pillar channel (F1) that produces CSRS: different sources, different units, separate evaluation. Nothing here is a probability of financial loss
